Fusion in Zamoskvorechye
Fusion in ZamoskvorechyeMoscow 2021

The interior design was inspired by the house and the atmosphere of the area where the apartment is located. Stalin's house with high ceilings in the historic center of Moscow. White walls like canvas were painted with bright spots of decor from the past. The steel kitchen, as a reflection of the rhythm of modern Moscow, coexists with the objects of the Soviet era.
